name: Tailgrids UI
summary: React component library on Tailwind CSS with 600+ components and blocks, templates, CLI and a Figma design system.
description: Open-source React component library built on Tailwind CSS with 600+ components and UI blocks for applications, marketing sites, e-commerce, dashboards and AI products. Ships copy-paste components, categorized blocks, ready-made templates, a CLI and a Figma design system; the core components are free under MIT while pro blocks, templates and the Figma file are paid.
